title: Edge Rule
description: One deterministic rule enforced locally by the ESP32-C3. The device holds max 8 rules. Inputs: button (1=pressed, 0=released), temp (chip temperature, deg C), level (simulated process level 0-100 %, rises while the button is held, drains when released).

id.description: Short unique rule id, e.g. r1

input.description: button: 1 = pressed, 0 = released. temp: chip temperature in deg C. level: simulated tank level in percent (0-100).

for_ms.description: Condition must hold continuously this long before the rule fires (0 = immediate).

type.description: Alarm output (LED). Priority when several rules fire: on > blink > off.

period_ms.description: Blink period (full on+off cycle). Use 0 for on/off. Blink requires >= 50.

latch.description: If true, once fired the action stays until the rule is cleared.

label.description: Optional: the plain-language sentence the rule was compiled from (shown on the device page). Set by the agent.
